description: This is a Java source file defining a class named RecipeService, which extends Android's Service class. It manages recipe-related notifications on an Android Wear OS device, creating a multi-page notification that displays details about cooking steps and a recipe image.

classes.name: RecipeService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages recipe notifications, showcasing recipe steps and images on wearable devices.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: An inner class extending Binder to provide clients with bound access to the RecipeService.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the NotificationManagerCompat instance when the service is created.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the Binder object for clients to bind to the service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start requests; if action is ACTION_START_COOKING, creates a recipe notification.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a multi-page notification based on the current Recipe object, including optional image and step details.
